Governance

Each FSI professional community is governed by a practitioner-led Advisory Council. Those councils, alongside the Editorial Advisory Board, Events Committees, and Education Committees, feed into the Five Star Executive Council, the association's unified governing body. Community membership at any level above Five Star Alliance carries advisory council eligibility.

Practitioners lead. The association serves.
